verdict.rationale: Claude analyzes user data inside the product. Users can upload CSV, XLSX, JSON and PDF files, including charts and images in PDFs. Claude can visualize data, produce reports with charts and visualizations from your documents, pull in Drive and Gmail data via connectors, and analyze data using your organization's workflows via Skills. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of data-analysis quality, and evidence of proactive suggestions rather than insights given only when prompted.
